tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Bio-mining of Legacy Waste (approx. 2,800 MT) at BILAGI Town Panchayath, Bagalkot District.

itemList.description:
Processing of accumulated waste shall be done in following manner :
(1) Volume of waste to be determined through contour survey (Total Station Survey) 
and site measurements. 
(2) Sprinkle the newly exposed surfaces with a composting with bio culture solution. This will control smell and speed up decomposition. With the help of Back Hoe loader, the waste in the demarcated area should be loosened up. 
(3) Raking of garbage layers by a long spike harrow operating in cross directions may be done as needed to pull out large rags, plastic, rubber, textiles etc. 
(4) Turn these windrow heaps once a week until no more volume reduction is observed in the heaps and no more heat is generated. 
(5) LB or its agency may deploy Trommels and/or Horizontal Screens or other types of screens for the purpose of screening. Screen the stabilized waste in a rotary screen or gravity screens of different size openings, preferably 35mm and 8mm.
(6) The recyclables recovered from the bio-mining process should be sent for recycling as per the quality of the material,
(7) The recyclables like plastic, glass, metals, rags and cloth recovered from the waste during screening shall be sorted out and preferably cleaned before sending to recycling industries or as RDF. 
(8) The heavy fractions may be sand and gravel usable for road shoulders or for plinth filling. Stones and concrete if any can be used for road sub-grade, or for crushing. recycling and reuse in the construction industry. 
(9) Usually the finest fraction will be organic matter plus fine soil, called ‘bio-earth’, 
which can be used as soil improver, especially for restoring alkaline or saline soils to fertility, or to grow some vegetation for erosion control.
(10) The recovered land from the bio-mining process shall be utilized for any purpose deemed appropriate. Ideally reclaimed space should be reused for waste processing, otherwise for alternate non-habitation uses.
(including GST)
